purpose: Register existing domain-level L1-L4 traceability contracts as evidence sources without promoting them to a second capability authority.
selectionRule: Only repository documents with explicit L1-L4 traceability/admission semantics are registered. No hierarchy is inferred from filenames, API routes, Payload collections, or feature-name similarity.
rules: A source document is evidence, not authority, until reconciled with Blueprint 2.0.
Overlapping domain documents must not create duplicate authorities.
Each admitted L4 must resolve to exactly one L3, L2, and L1 parent chain.
Missing owner, authority, lifecycle, authorization, or acceptance evidence remains blocking.
No 449 Feature ID is admitted by this registry alone.
